name: Cleda Marie Decker (Merithew)
milestones: Married Harold Romeyn Merithew Sr. (m. 31 Jul 1931)
sources: Ancestry.com, public member tree "Bicha-Dale Family Tree" (tree 8839537)
notes: Daughter of Clyde and Merle (Waddell) Decker. Born 15 Jul 1914 at Bronson, Michigan; married Harold Romeyn Merithew Sr. on 31 Jul 1931 in Elkhart County, Indiana; died 25 Sep 1941 at Howell, Michigan, the day her daughter Gay Marie was born, and was buried there on 28 Sep. The tree lists seven children: Philip, Susan, Sharon, Gay Marie and three living.
